audit_metadata.title: Final Conditional Calibration and Research Readiness Gate
audit_metadata.safety_verdict: VERIFIED OFFLINE RESEARCH ONLY -- V5 FROZEN -- ZERO EXECUTION

interpretative_findings.gaussian_and_t_preservation: For Gaussian IID and standardized Student-t(5) distributions, the screening pass rate is ~87%. The conditional Type I error rate among Category A datasets closely mirrors the unconditional rate (delta <= 0.5 pp), indicating that the multi-diagnostic pre-test does not induce material selection bias under true white noise.
interpretative_findings.persistence_suppression: For AR(1) phi=0.30, AR(1) phi=0.50, and AR(2) bimodal dependence, the screening pass rate is exactly 0.00% (0/500). The multi-diagnostic screen successfully blocks 100% of these persistent processes from entering Category A, preventing uncalibrated bootstrap inference on persistent series.
interpretative_findings.garch_filtering: For GARCH(1,1) volatility clustering, the McLeod-Li test flags ~95% of datasets into Category B/C. Only ~5% of GARCH datasets survive into Category A. Due to the small surviving sample denominator (K_A ~ 20-30), conditional Type I estimates exhibit higher Wilson uncertainty. Stricter sensitivity sweep reporting (L in {5,10,20}) remains mandatory.

phase_c_parity_and_seeds.interpretation: Consuming identical pre-generated block start indices eliminates PRNG divergence, producing identical replicate statistics down to machine precision (< 1.00e-16). Exceedance counts and finite Monte Carlo p-values match with 100% exact parity.

Category_A.label: SCREENING PASS -- DEPENDENCE NOT DETECTED BY SPECIFIED DIAGNOSTICS; ASSUMPTIONS NOT PROVEN
Category_A.conditions: Candidate series with sample size N >= 500, passing the multi-diagnostic pre-test gate: Ljung-Box Q10 (p >= 0.05), McLeod-Li Q10 (p >= 0.05), and Bonferroni Bartlett bounds (|r_k| < z_{1-0.05/20}/sqrt(N) for all k in 1..10). If AR(2) is fitted, companion matrix eigenvalues must satisfy max(|lambda_i|) < 0.50.
Category_A.block_length_policy: L=10 is retained strictly as an empirical reference baseline for N approx 500-1000, NOT as a universally valid or optimal block length. Optimal block length scales as O(N^(1/3)). Inference MUST report the sensitivity sweep across L in {5, 10, 20} as a fragility diagnostic. Selecting the minimum p-value across L (p-hacking) is strictly prohibited. If conclusions cross significance thresholds between L=5 and L=20, the result is demoted to Category C.
permitted_claims: Moving-block bootstrap excess return evaluation relative to benchmark under reference L=10 with reported L in {5, 20} sensitivity.
Omnibus diagnostics did not detect linear autocorrelation or ARCH volatility clustering at the 5% level.
prohibited_claims: Claims that returns are proven i.i.d., independent, or uncorrelated.
Claims of validated, guaranteed, or forward live profitability.
Claims that nominal bootstrap calibration is mathematically exact without variance inflation.

Category_B.label: DEPENDENCE FLAGGED -- STANDARD INFERENCE REQUIRES CAUTION
Category_B.conditions: Linear autocorrelation flagged or ARCH volatility clustering flagged, provided persistence remains moderate (|rho_1| < 0.30 and AR(2) companion eigenvalue max(|lambda_i|) < 0.50) and N >= 500.
permitted_claims: Provisional inference reported strictly across block lengths L in {5, 10, 20}.
2D DSR sensitivity grid (M in [1, 150], sigma_M in [0.30, 1.00]) displayed with documented variance inflation.
prohibited_claims: Selecting the minimum p-value across L in {5, 10, 20} (p-hacking).
Presenting unadjusted bootstrap p-values as definitive statistical significance.

Category_C.label: INCONCLUSIVE / STRUCTURAL LIMITATION
Category_C.conditions: Any of the following disqualifying conditions: 1. Sample size N < 500 (operational policy floor). 2. High autoregressive persistence: |rho_1| >= 0.30 or AR(2) companion eigenvalue max(|lambda_i|) >= 0.50. 3. Inestimable AR(2) or singular covariance. 4. Fragility instability: conclusions cross significance thresholds between L=5 and L=20. 5. Unknown historical trial counts M, macro regime shifts, or execution slippage invariance.
permitted_claims: Statement that the empirical evidence is statistically inconclusive due to excessive persistence, sample inadequacy, fragility instability, or structural limitations.
prohibited_claims: Any claim of statistical significance, outperformance, edge, or alpha.

epistemological_distinctions.1_engineering_correctness: Code executes the specified formulas without bugs, leaks, or lookahead.
epistemological_distinctions.2_screening_status: Diagnostic pre-tests did or did not flag specified dependencies; never proves independence.
epistemological_distinctions.3_bootstrap_calibration: Empirical Type I error control under controlled synthetic processes.
epistemological_distinctions.4_dsr_evidence: Model-dependent statistic relative to EVT expected maximum noise hurdle under Gaussian trial assumptions.
epistemological_distinctions.5_out_of_sample_edge: Statistical superiority over benchmark on untouched forward data partitions.
epistemological_distinctions.6_economic_profitability: Real-world net trading gains after fees, slippage, latency, and market impact.

phase_d_research_policy.frozen_strategy_status: Strategy V5 remains frozen under VERIFIED NO-GO. All execution pathways remain disabled.

final_framework_verdict: ACCEPT FOR OFFLINE EXPLORATORY COMPARATIVE RESEARCH WITH DOCUMENTED LIMITATIONS
